title: Scalar-forgetting comparison (negative)
statement: Let Λ be a commutative ring, k:W→S a morphism, G a Λ-module etale sheaf on W, q a negative integer and U→S any etale object. For every A in Over W the fixed raw group Hom((A.hom≫k)^*Λ[U][0],A.hom^*G[q]) is additively isomorphic to H^q(U×_S A,pr_A^*A.hom^*G_ab[0]). These isomorphisms intertwine, for every morphism f:A→B over W, the five-factor higherDirectImageRawOverPullbackHom with restrictedOverCohomologyMap on G_ab. No limit, affineness or qcqs assumption is imposed.

proof.text: Raw Hom vanishes by orthogonality of degree-zero source and target in degrees at least -q > 0. Right derived global sections of a sheaf in degree zero have no negative homology. Use the unique isomorphism of zero objects; every naturality square has zero source.

from.place: The negative-degree part of the natural comparison

lean.statement:
theorem exists_rawModule_restrictedAbelian_negative
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {W S : Scheme.{u}} (k : W ⟶ S)
    (G : Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (q : ℤ) (U : S.Etale)
    (hq : q < 0) :
    ∃ e : ∀ A : Over W,
      (higherDirectImageRawOverFunctor Λ k G q U).obj (op A) ≅
        restrictedOverCohomology k
          ((sheafCompose _ (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj G)
          q A U,
      ∀ (A B : Over W) (f : A ⟶ B),
        (higherDirectImageRawOverFunctor Λ k G q U).map f.op ≫ (e A).hom =
          (e B).hom ≫ restrictedOverCohomologyMap k
            ((sheafCompose _ (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj G)
            q f U
